newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 24.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Tuesday.

WASHINGTON - The Republicans' desire for a swift and neat resolution of House Speaker Newt Gingrich's confessed ethical breach before the new Congress convenes on January 7 and votes on a new speaker has begun to run into serious obstacles that could foil their strategy.

WASHINGTON - For three years now, House Speaker Newt Gingrich has contended that there was little if any overlap between his political activities and his supposedly nonpartisan educational endeavours.
WASHINGTON - William Leidinger, fired as Fairfax County executive in October, left office with a $275,000 payoff from taxpayers in severance and benefits.

WASHINGTON - A Dale City father of three died of gunshot wounds he received when five teenage gang members riddled a house with bullets, about an hour after they were turned away from a Christmas party inside.
PARIS - Two private groups are suing the American sponsors of an English-only site on the Internet's World Wide Web because the material on it is not also available in French.
